title: Learning Low-Latency Action Verification for Frozen Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.14834v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have made significant progress in general-purpose robotic manipulation. However, sampled action sequences can be ineffective, while evaluating alternatives with computationally expensive verifiers adds latency at each policy query. In this work, we propose HDH, a lightweight framework that uses hindsight from a frozen VLA's own deployments to improve action verification. The framework has three stages. First, we deploy the policy and collect its autonomous rollouts. We then train a compact action verifier to assign each action chunk a predicted task-success score. Finally, the frozen VLA generates action candidates, and the verifier selects the candidate with the highest score for execution. Across four LIBERO-10 tasks, HDH achieves an average success rate of 82.3\% and on three real-world manipulation tasks, HDH improves average success over the baseline policy by 22.6\%.

translated_title: 为冻结的视觉-语言-动作模型学习低延迟动作验证
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用机器人操作领域取得了显著进展。然而，采样得到的动作序列可能是无效的，而使用计算开销高昂的验证器来评估备选方案会在每次策略查询时增加延迟。在这项工作中，我们提出了HDH，一个轻量级框架，它利用冻结VLA自身部署中的后见之明信息来改进动作验证。该框架包含三个阶段：首先，我们部署策略并收集其自主执行轨迹；然后，我们训练一个紧凑的动作验证器，为每个动作块分配预测的任务成功分数；最后，冻结的VLA生成动作候选，验证器选择得分最高的候选进行执行。在四个LIBERO-10任务上，HDH实现了82.3%的平均成功率；在三个真实世界操作任务上，HDH将相对于基线策略的平均成功率提升了22.6%。
tldr: HDH提出了一种轻量级低延迟动作验证框架，利用冻结VLA自身部署产生的数据训练紧凑验证器，从候选动作块中挑选最可能成功的动作，在LIBERO-10上达到82.3%的平均成功率，并在真实任务上较基线提升22.6%。
en_tdlr: HDH is a lightweight, low-latency action verification framework that trains a compact verifier from a frozen VLA's own deployment rollouts to select the most promising action candidate, achieving 82.3% average success on LIBERO-10 and a 22.6% improvement over the baseline policy on real-world tasks.
